blocks.text: Observer Design Pattern logon ke aise group jaisa hai jo ek hi source (zariya) se updates lene mein dilchaspi rakhte hain. Jab bhi koi aham baat hoti hai, source khud ba khud tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon ko bata deta hai. Yeh sab ko ek jaisi maloomat par (in sync) rakhne ka tareeqa hai, baghair is ke ke har koi baar baar updates check kare.

blocks.prompt: Observer pattern har object ke baar baar source check karne se behtar kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Baar baar check karna mehnat zaya karta hai aur do checks ke darmiyan update chhoot sakta hai. Observer pattern mein source update hote hi ek dafa tamam observers ko bata deta hai.

items: Observer: kuch hone par source tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon ko khud batata hai; baar baar check nahi karna parta.
